Class SubscriberController

java.lang.Object
com.andreibel.server.controller.SubscriberController
public class SubscriberController extends Object
Handles subscriber-related API calls coming from the network layer.

This controller is a thin routing/adaptation layer between incoming Message objects and the SubscriberService (and related services). Each method is responsible for:

  • extracting and casting the expected payload from Message.getData()
  • delegating the operation to the service layer
  • wrapping the result into a response Message with the correct API type

Payload contract: In this controller, the payload is usually an Integer subscriber id (for read operations) or a SubscriberRequest (for create/update). If the payload type does not match, a ClassCastException may occur.

Singleton: implemented as a singleton to keep one controller instance during server runtime.

Author:
Andrei Beloziyorove

    • getAllSub

      public com.andreibel.message.Message getAllSub()
      Retrieves all subscribers from the system.

      Response: GET_ALL_SUBSCRIBERS_RESPONSE with List<SubscriberResponse> on success, or GET_ALL_SUBSCRIBERS_ERROR if the list is null or empty.

      Returns:
      response message containing all subscribers or an error type

    • getSub

      public com.andreibel.message.Message getSub(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Retrieves a single subscriber by id (used for subscriber login / fetch by id).

      Expected payload: Integer subscriber id in message.getData().

      Response: SUBSCRIBER_LOGIN_RESPONSE with SubscriberResponse on success, or SUBSCRIBER_LOGIN_ERROR if not found.

      Parameters:
      message - request message containing an Integer subscriber id
      Returns:
      response message containing the subscriber or an error type

    • getSubOrders

      public com.andreibel.message.Message getSubOrders(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Retrieves a subscriber and their orders by subscriber id.

      Expected payload: Integer subscriber id in message.getData().

      Response: GET_SUBSCRIBER_ORDERS_RESPONSE with SubscriberResponse (including orders) on success, or GET_SUBSCRIBER_ORDERS_ERROR if the request is invalid or data is missing.

      Note: your current implementation checks message.getData() == null after calling the service. Typically you want to check subscriber == null instead.

      Parameters:
      message - request message containing an Integer subscriber id
      Returns:
      response message containing the subscriber + orders or an error type

    • createSub

      public com.andreibel.message.Message createSub(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Creates a new subscriber.

      Expected payload: SubscriberRequest in message.getData().

      Response: CREATE_SUBSCRIBER_RESPONSE with SubscriberResponse on success, or CREATE_SUBSCRIBER_ERROR if creation failed.

      Parameters:
      message - request message containing SubscriberRequest
      Returns:
      response message containing the created subscriber or an error type

    • updateSub

      public com.andreibel.message.Message updateSub(com.andreibel.message.Message message)
      Updates an existing subscriber.

      Expected payload: SubscriberRequest containing the subscriber id and updated fields.

      Response: UPDATE_SUBSCRIBER_RESPONSE with SubscriberResponse on success, or UPDATE_SUBSCRIBER_ERROR if update failed.

      Parameters:
      message - request message containing SubscriberRequest
      Returns:
      response message containing the updated subscriber or an error type
